_note: Folder-owned PUBLIC MIRROR declaration (ClosedSource/scripts/mirror_public.rb; OpenSource/CanvasEditor/mirror.json documents the schema). This folder is the source of truth and the mirror is a generated read-only copy, so PRs happen here and never there. THIS MIRROR IS THE 'READ THE CODE' PROMISE MADE PHYSICAL: the Swift and Kotlin kernels had no public face at all — npm carries only the TypeScript twin — so the changelog's 'core runtime open sourced' claim was unverifiable by anyone outside this repo. `vendor` grafts the whole shared conformance corpus in at conformance/, which is the second half of the claim: a reader can see the fixtures that hold the three kernels identical, which is what makes 'parity is falsifiable' a fact rather than a slogan. Package.swift is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: SPM is blocked behind Phase K (Despia's own app must import DSX before we hand strangers a resolvable package — the dogfood law, publication-plan.md), and a Package.swift at a mirror root is exactly what SPM resolves, so shipping it would quietly open a distribution face nobody has proven. This mirror is source to read, vendor, and audit; the consumable Swift face comes later and on purpose. `check` is the kernel package gate, which is the one command that asserts a single version across every face and that no app symbol is reachable from the kernel — a mirror must never ship something the monorepo's own gate would reject. `tag_from` is the bare VERSION file, so the kernel's one semver cuts the v<version> tag with no second place to bump.
